_about: What testers see in TestFlight. scripts/testflight.py writes it to App Store Connect after each upload (betaAppLocalizations and betaBuildLocalizations of Apple's API). The feedback address is the TESTFLIGHT_TESTER_EMAIL secret, never stored here.
description: Wartabiye TV: news from Somalia, East Africa, the world and sport, the same stories as wartabiyetv.com, in nine languages (Somali, English, Arabic, French, Dutch, Italian, Turkish, German and Spanish). Somali is the default; the chosen language is kept.
whatsNew: Please try: the news on the home screen, opening a story (it stays inside the app), switching between the nine languages (the choice must be kept after closing the app and restarting the iPhone), Search, Saved articles, the Somalia, World and Sport sections, LIVE, text size and dark mode. Notifications can be turned on in Settings.
